sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:180634
Court No. - 70

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 40744 of 2023
Applicant :- Priyanshu

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Kameshwar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Heard Sri Kameshwar Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Imran Khan, learned AGA for the State.

2. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 313 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 .P. Act, Police Station Tindwari,
District Banda during pendency of the trial.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant and his family members and according to the FIR marriage of the applicant was performed with the daughter of the informant on 18.02.2022 and after marriage applicant and his family members tortured her for Rs. 1 lakh.

It is further mentioned in the FIR that on 25.05.2022 father of the applicant i.e. father-in-law of the deceased tried to outrage the modesty of the deceased i.e. his daughter-in-law and after five months of the incident of sexual assault again applicant and his family members stared torturing the deceased and on 20.12.2022 applicant and his family members committed her murder.

Priyanshu vs State Of U.P. on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177350116/
1 4.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased and totally on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, he has been made accused in the present matter and story narrated by the informant in the FIR prima facie appears to be quite vague and no reliance can be placed on such version.
5. He further submits that in the FIR apart from allegation of demand of dowry there is also allegation of sexual assault against father-in-law, which is improbable.

He further submits that even in the FIR it is mentioned that after alleged incident of sexual assault by the father of the applicant after five months applicant and his family members again started making allegation of demand of dowry and this fact clearly suggests that actually there was no demand of dowry.

6. He further submits that actually marriage of the deceased was performed with the applicant against her wishes and she was having love affair with one Biru Sharma @ Virendra Sharma @
Tinku of her village, therefore, only due to this reason deceased within ten months of her marriage she committed suicide by hanging herself.
7. He further submits that post mortem report of the deceased suggests that deceased died due to hanging and her hyoid bone was found intact.
He further submits that applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 23.12.2022.

8. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died within ten months of her marriage under abnormal circumstances in her matrimonial home and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but could not dispute the fact that in the FIR along with allegation of demand of dowry and torture there is also allegation of sexual assault against father-in-law of the deceased and father-in-law of the deceased has already been released on bail and in paragraphs 24 and 25 of the affidavit, applicant has made specific averment that marriage of the deceased was performed against her wishes as she was having love affair with some another boy.
9.
Learned AGA further could not dispute the fact that as per post mortem report, deceased died due to hanging and her hyoid bone was found intact.
10. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

11. Although, applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died within ten months of her marriage under abnormal circumstances in her matrimonial home and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but FIR of the present case is quite lengthy one and apart from the allegation of demand of dowry there is also allegation of sexual assault against father-in-law of the deceased,
which appears to be quite improbable.
12.

Further, in paragraphs 24 and 25 of the affidavit applicant has made specific averment that deceased was having love affair with another boy before her marriage and her marriage was performed against her wishes, therefore, she committed suicide.
The defence taken by the applicant cannot be completely brushed aside at this stage.

Priyanshu vs State Of U.P. on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177350116/
2 13.

Further, from the record it reflects that deceased died due to hanging and her hyoid bone was found intact and father-in-law of the deceased has already been released on bail by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 19.05.203 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 12362 of 2023.
14.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 12362 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
15. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

16. Let the applicant - Priyanshu be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
17.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

18. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.

Order Date :- 19.9.2023 AK Pandey  Priyanshu vs State Of U.P. on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177350116/
